description: This PHP file defines the ExceptionSubscriber class, which subscribes to Symfony's kernel exception events to handle errors globally within the OrangeHRM application. It modifies the HTTP response based on the exception encountered.

classes.name: ExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to exception events in Symfony's HTTP kernel to customize responses when exceptions occur.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the Kernel exception event to the handler method 'onExceptionEvent' with a priority of -65.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the ExceptionEvent, sets an appropriate HTTP response based on whether the exception is an HttpExceptionInterface or a general exception.
